column3: N=$(grep -m1 "^p cnf" $INST | cut -d" " -f3); D=$(dirname $CERT); if [ ${N:-0} -lt 5000000 ]; then $BIN0 --silent --proof-dense-crossover 60 --component-limit 500000 --order-model-limit 750000 --dense-model-limit 20000000 --add-reduced-as-unit --preprocess-cnf-unit -f $INST --proof-file $CERT --out-file $D/temporary.cnf; $BIN1 -q --no-binary --witnessmaxvar=$N $D/temporary.cnf $CERT; else echo "pseudo-Boolean proof version 3.0" > $CERT; $BIN1 -q --no-binary --witnessmaxvar=$N $INST $CERT; fi; R=$?; [ $R -eq 20 ] && { echo "output NONE;" >> $CERT; echo "conclusion UNSAT;" >> $CERT; echo "end pseudo-Boolean proof;" >> $CERT; }; rm -f $D/temporary.cnf; exit $R
